fields.Name: C1 -> S9.1
fields.Description: Gate G3.6 (owner PR 4, phase 3, dataset C1, criterion S9.1): 100% of the Published models in the suite database have a publish record naming the approver (the automated gate or a named user), the time, the gate decision and the evidence snapshot (holdout with its interval, a baseline comparison, the leakage audit, the data window and the snapshot hash). The audit reads every MJ: ML Models row with Status 'Published', unfiltered, each joined to its latest applied publish record (Kind 'publish', Purpose 'publish' or 'rollback'); before measuring, the gate publishes the W1-signal s42 fixture through the lifecycle gate as the suite user, and one Pipeline Builder run on W1-signal s42 under a supplied protocol with autoPublishKeepBaseline true (owner ruling 2026-11-16, OF4-30) publishes automatically, so a clean database holds a Published model of each approver kind (user and automated-gate). It fails when a publish commits without its publish record, or the record lacks the evidence snapshot. Mutation: skip WritePublishRecord in LifecycleGate.applyPublish when the approver is automated-gate -> below 100% (the gate's own automatic publish has no record); on M4, where every publish was interactive, the same skip for a user approver -> 0 of 1.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every Published model has a complete publish record: approver, RecordedAt, gate decision and evidence snapshot, 100%.
